title: Software Engineer
description:
### **Software Engineer (C\+\+)**

**The Firm**
------------


Teesta Investment is a proprietary high\-frequency trading (HFT) and market\-making firm focused on global digital asset markets. We build automated trading systems that operate 24×7 across global crypto markets, where software, infrastructure, and quantitative research come together to make decisions in microseconds.


Unlike traditional software, trading systems operate under demanding constraints. Market data is continuous, latency directly influences outcomes, and every layer of the technology stack, from operating systems and networking to execution engines and infrastructure, contributes to performance. Building these systems requires engineers who enjoy solving difficult technical problems with precision and discipline.


At Teesta, engineers work alongside traders and quantitative researchers to design technology that is reliable, scalable, and built for production from day one. We believe great engineering comes from curiosity, ownership, and a relentless focus on continuous improvement.

**The Team**
------------


This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in our Kolkata or Mumbai office.


You'll join a small, highly technical engineering team responsible for developing the software that powers our trading platform. The team works closely with traders and quantitative researchers to build systems that process market data, execute trades, and support research across global digital asset markets.


We value engineers who are intellectually curious, enjoy working close to the hardware and operating system, and take pride in writing software that is efficient, reliable, and maintainable.

**The Role**
------------


Building software for high\-frequency trading is unlike building conventional applications.


Trading systems must process large volumes of real\-time market data, respond within extremely tight latency constraints, and remain reliable throughout constantly changing market conditions. Performance, correctness, and robustness are equally important, and even small engineering improvements can have a measurable impact.


As a Software Engineer, you'll contribute to the development of the core systems that power our trading platform. Working closely with experienced engineers, you'll build software that combines low\-level systems programming with modern software engineering practices.


Depending on your experience, your work may include:

* Designing, developing, testing, and maintaining high\-performance applications using modern C\+\+.
* Building components that process real\-time market data and support low\-latency trade execution.
* Applying data structures and algorithms to solve complex performance\-critical problems.
* Working with operating system concepts to improve application performance, efficiency, and reliability.
* Collaborating with senior engineers, traders, and quantitative researchers to design and implement robust technical solutions.
* Participating in code reviews and engineering discussions to improve software quality and share knowledge.
* Monitoring and troubleshooting production systems to maintain high availability and operational reliability.
* Exploring new technologies, development tools, and engineering practices that improve system performance and developer productivity.


This role offers the opportunity to work on technically challenging systems where engineering decisions have a direct impact on production performance.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


We're looking for engineers with strong computer science fundamentals and a passion for building high\-performance software.


You should have:

* 1 to 3 years of professional software development experience, preferably in high\-frequency trading, algorithmic trading, fintech, or another performance\-sensitive environment.
* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong proficiency in modern C\+\+ with experience writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
* A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and computational complexity.
* Strong knowledge of computer architecture and how hardware and software interact.
* Good understanding of operating systems, including processes, threads, memory management, scheduling, and performance.
* Basic understanding of computer networking concepts and network protocols.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to continuously learn new technologies.


Experience in high\-frequency trading or cryptocurrency markets is beneficial but not essential. Exceptional software engineers with strong systems programming fundamentals and an eagerness to learn are encouraged to apply.

**Why Join Teesta?**
--------------------


Joining Teesta means working on software that directly powers our trading business.


You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, traders, and quantitative researchers to solve technically challenging problems, gain exposure to modern low\-latency systems, and develop software where performance and correctness matter every day.


As part of a small engineering team, you'll have meaningful ownership, opportunities to learn across the technology stack, and the chance to contribute to systems that operate at the limits of speed and reliability.

**Benefits**
------------

* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your dependants.
* Relocation assistance.
* Fitness and wellness reimbursement.
* Sponsorship for higher education and professional development.
* Fully stocked office with snacks and beverages.
* A collaborative, engineering\-first culture with high ownership and continuous learning.

title: Cloud Native IOT Software Engineer
description:
M.B. Control \& Systems Pvt. Ltd, is an ISO\-9001 company. Since our inception in 1983, we have been
  

committed to provide innovative electronic systems and equipment for control and monitoring of
  

industrial processes. We design, manufacture, install and commission industrial electronics systems on
  

turnkey basis.

  

  

Our system solutions are suitable for Energy management systems, Weather Monitoring Solutions,
  

Telemetry Systems, Remote Data Collection System, Remote Meter Reading Solutions, RTU Control
  

Panels and Systems, SCADA systems and Sub\-Station Automation Systems. Required energy reports are
  

provided as part of the system.


Our team of experts is available to dispense expert technical support, and provide technical solutions to
  

questions ranging from generic to complex. We consider excellence of products and service as a key to
  

gaining customer loyalty and satisfaction. We have pan India presence via dealer and distribution
  

network.

  

  

All the products we offer can be viewed on our website www.mbcontrol.com. We have clients such as in
  

power generation (wind, solar, hydro etc.), OEM, Transmission, IPP, CPP, Heavy Industries etc.


**Achieve your potential \- build an exciting career**  



Discover the opportunity to join a dynamic, and responsible company that fosters the development of
  

all its people and communities around the world. Every day, we challenge employees to achieve more
  

and experience exciting careers.

  

  

**JOB PROFILE:**

We are seeking a skilled IoT Engineer to design, develop, and integrate IIoT solutions for power,
  

renewable energy, SCADA, telemetry, and energy management applications. The role involves full\-
  

stack development, mobile applications, industrial protocols, field\-device integration, cloud and edge
  

systems, and real\-time data platforms. Experience with AI\-assisted coding agents, protocol
  

troubleshooting, MQTT, BLE, Python, and hardware validation is highly valued, along with strong
  

documentation, testing, and problem\-solving skills.


Designation: Cloud Native IOT Software Engineer


Department: Research \& Development


Reports to: Senior IOT Engineer


Location: Full Time On\-Site, Howrah


**Must have**  

  

* Node.js and JavaScript, with Express REST APIs in production
* React — hooks, routing, state management, a component library such as MUI
* Kotlin and Android, ideally Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose; iOS/Swift exposure
* MongoDB and Mongoose — schema design, queries, indexes
* TypeScript — or clear readiness to move to it; new work is TS\-first
* Git, code review, and writing tests that mean something
* Comfort reading a protocol spec and a message dump side by side, and trusting the dump
* Clear written English — our projects run on written specs, plans and open\-item registers

  

**Strong plus**  

  

* MQTT (Mosquitto, MQTT 5, QoS, retained messages) or similar pub/sub messaging
* Bluetooth Low Energy — GATT services, characteristics, MTU, notifications, connection lifecycle
* Python for tooling, test harnesses and simulators
* Industrial protocols and hardware — Modbus RTU, RS\-485, XBee, IEDs, inverters, energy meters, weather sensors
* SQLite and query builders such as Kysely
* SCADA, energy or utility domain experience
* Bash scripting, CLI tools and git hooks
* Building MCP servers or other API integrations in Python

  

**Agentic coding — required**  

  

We work with AI coding agents daily, mainly Claude Code, and it is part of the job rather than a side experiment.
  

  

**You should be able to**:
  

  

* Drive an agent through real work — multi\-file changes, refactors, debugging against live hardware — not just

autocomplete
  

* Write and maintain the context that agents run on: project specs, plans, open\-item registers

CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md files, and reusable skills
  

* Set up guardrails — hooks, gated workflows, permission settings — so an agent's output stays reviewable and safe
* Review agent output critically. You own every line that lands, and you are expected to catch the confident\-but\-wrong

answer. This matters more than speed
  

* Know when not to use one: hardware bring\-up, protocol reverse\-engineering and judgment calls still need a human at

the bench
  

  

Prior experience with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar is expected. Tell us about a non\-trivial piece of work you
  

shipped this way, including what the agent got wrong.
  

  

**How we work**  

  

* Written first — every project carries a spec, a plan and a single register of open items
* Small trunk\-based repos, reviewed commits, local CI checks before push
* Work tracked in Open Project
* Verify against real devices; a passing test on a simulator is not a finished feature

* Findings get written down and stay written down, so the next person isn't re\-deriving them
  

  

**Qualifications:**  



 Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Computer Science, or related
  

Engineering field.


 Minimum Exp. 3\-4 years


 Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.


 Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.


 Good communication and documentation abilities.


 Ability to work independently and in multidisciplinary teams.
  

 Location: Howrah
